_note: The Dutch body `case.caseDeclaredMajor` shipped without (#2859). The routing lane (#2868) swept the ROUTED rules for a Dutch body and reported this one rather than fixing it, because a rule with no `domain` belongs to the lane that wrote it. This fragment gives it its wording and nothing else: no `domain`, because which domain a calamiteit falls under is a routing decision and not this one. Without a body the responder gets a derived notice, which reads as the subject line twice.

message.nl: Deze zaak is opgeschaald naar calamiteit. Open de zaak en pak je rol op.
message.en: This case has been declared major. Open it and take up your part.
